s: March 8, 2025 - Claudia Livia, often known as Livilla, was a prominent and tragic figure in the Julio-Claudian dynasty. She was the only daughter of Nero Claudius Drusus and Antonia Minor, making her the sister to the Roman Emperor Claudius and the general Germanicus. As the paternal aunt of Emperor Caligula and maternal great-aunt of Emperor Nero, Livilla’s family connections placed her in a complex web of power and intrigue.
